observations: Photo 0: Front view of a Toyota pickup with TRD-style grille/trim and fog lights; headlights and grille are intact; front bumper has a black lower section.
Photo 1: Front 3/4 view shows the same pickup; front wheels/tires look like off-road/AT style; no obvious missing parts visible.
Photo 2: Rear view shows a Toyota pickup with “V6” badge visible on the tailgate area; rear bumper and tail lights appear intact; no visible major damage from this angle.

identity.model: Tacoma (TRD 4x4 shown by seller text; model name not clearly readable in photos)

claims.claim: foreign used 2024 toyota tocoma trd 4x4 with v6 engine
claims.evidence: Photos show a Toyota pickup and a visible “V6” badge on photo 2, but the year (2024), exact model (Tacoma) and TRD 4x4 status are not clearly readable from the photos provided.
No photo shows the dashboard/ignition/push-button area.
No photo shows the roof/glass panel.
No customs/duty document is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: No inspection report, panel gaps/paint thickness, or engine bay photos are provided to confirm repair history.
No running video, OBD scan, or dashboard warning-light check is shown.

risks.risk: Year/trim mismatch (seller may be claiming 2024 and TRD 4x4, but photos don’t clearly confirm year/trim). This affects value significantly.
risks.proof: Send a photo of the VIN plate (dashboard VIN) and the vehicle registration/inspection document showing year and trim; also a photo of the door jamb sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Toyota Tacoma V6 pickup with unknown year/trim (worst case vs claimed 2024 TRD 4x4).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition not verifiable from exterior photos (engine/transmission/4x4 system could have faults).
risks.proof: Short video of cold start + 5–10 minutes driving, plus a dashboard scan screenshot (OBD) showing no active faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven mechanically (worst case: assume needs checks/possible minor issues).

risks.risk: Push-to-start and moonroof may not exist or may not work (not shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the push-button start area and a roof/overhead shot showing the moonroof glass; include a quick open/close video.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming these features (worst case: treat as not confirmed).

risks.risk: Duty/customs status not verifiable (could be unverified import).
risks.proof: Photos of duty payment/clearance documents (customs release) and any verification letter.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if duty verification is not confirmed (worst case: buyer may face additional costs/risks).

risks.risk: Accident/repair history not verifiable (exterior can look clean while panels/structure are repaired).
risks.proof: Provide paint meter readings (or at least close-up photos of panel seams + undercarriage photos) and a body/accident report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially repaired/unknown history (worst case vs “never repaired”).

proof_requests: VIN plate photo (dashboard) + door jamb sticker photo (year/trim/engine details).
Photo of the registration/inspection document showing the exact year (2024) and model/trim.
Cold-start video + short drive video; include OBD scan screenshot showing no active fault codes.
Roof/overhead photo showing moonroof; push-to-start button/ignition area photo.
Customs/duty verification documents (clearance/release) and photos of receipt/warranty pages.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Toyota pickup with a visible V6 badge, but the key pricing drivers in the seller’s claims (exact year, Tacoma/TRD 4x4 trim, push-to-start, moonroof, verified duty, and mechanical/repair history) are not provable from the provided images. Without proof, a worst-case price can’t be confidently matched to the correct comparable set.
